title: Up, Up, My Soul, on Wings of Praise
description: Up, Up, My Soul, on Wings of Praise in Tonic Solfa to ST. AGNES, doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: John Brownlie translated these words from the Greek service books for Hymns of the Greek Church (Edinburgh and London, 1900).
The book printed the words without tunes. They are in Common Metre (8.6.8.6), and this page sets them to ST. AGNES; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Up, up, my soul, on wings of praise, No oth-er ser-vice know; In ho-ly strains the love ex-press That fires the heart be-low.

lines: Up, up, my soul, on wings of praise,
In holy strains the love express
Burn, burn, my soul, and ever be
And, strongly armed with firm resolve,
And weave a garland rich and fair
To crown the King of gods.

source: John Brownlie, Hymns of the Greek Church (1900)
licence: Public domain: John Brownlie died in 1925.
credits: Translated by John Brownlie (1857–1925) from the Greek, public domain, as printed in Hymns of the Greek Church; set to ST. AGNES by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
